Title: Jailbreaking Large Language Models with Symbolic Mathematics

In this paper, the authors propose a novel jailbreaking technique called MathPrompt, which exploits the advanced symbolic mathematics capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to bypass their safety mechanisms. The authors transform harmful natural language prompts into mathematical problems and present them to the target LLM, demonstrating a critical vulnerability in current AI safety measures. Their experiments across 13 state-of-the-art LLMs show an average attack success rate of 73.6%, highlighting the inability of existing safety training mechanisms to generalize to mathematically encoded inputs. The authors emphasize the importance of a holistic approach to AI safety, calling for expanded red-teaming efforts to develop robust safeguards across all potential input types and their associated risks.
